title: T05 Buy, Sell, Long and Short

lines.text: Lesson five: buy, sell, long and short. Welcome to Phase 2.
lines.say: Lesson five: buy, sell, long and short. Welcome to Phase two.

lines.text: BTC's price goes up, and it goes down. Most people only think about one direction.
lines.say: B-T-C's price goes up, and it goes down. Most people only think about one direction.

lines.text: Can someone gain when the price falls? With a short position, yes. Let's see how.
lines.say: Can someone gain when the price falls? With a short position, yes. Let's see how.

lines.text: First, spot trading. Buying spot means you pay USDT now and receive real BTC.
lines.say: First, spot trading. Buying spot means you pay U-S-D-T now and receive real B-T-C.

lines.text: Like buying gold at a shop: you pay, and the gold is yours to keep.
lines.say: Like buying gold at a shop: you pay, and the gold is yours to keep.

lines.text: You pay 600 USDT for 0.01 BTC at 60,000. Your USDT goes down, your BTC goes up.
lines.say: You pay six hundred U-S-D-T for zero point zero one B-T-C at sixty thousand. Your U-S-D-T goes down, your B-T-C goes up.

lines.text: Selling spot is the reverse. Sell the 0.01 BTC at 62,000, and you get 620 USDT back.
lines.say: Selling spot is the reverse. Sell the zero point zero one B-T-C at sixty-two thousand, and you get six hundred twenty U-S-D-T back.

lines.text: Spot is ownership. The BTC is yours, and its value rises and falls with the price.
lines.say: Spot is ownership. The B-T-C is yours, and its value rises and falls with the price.

lines.text: Futures are different. A futures contract is an agreement about an asset's price.
lines.say: Futures are different. A futures contract is an agreement about an asset's price.

lines.text: Opening one gives you a position: you gain or lose as the price moves, but you own no BTC.
lines.say: Opening one gives you a position: you gain or lose as the price moves, but you own no B-T-C.

lines.text: Going long means opening a position that gains if the price rises.
lines.say: Going long means opening a position that gains if the price rises.

lines.text: Like agreeing today to buy a crate of mangoes at today's price. If prices rise, your deal is worth more.
lines.say: Like agreeing today to buy a crate of mangoes at today's price. If prices rise, your deal is worth more.

lines.text: Long 0.01 BTC at 60,000. If the price rises to 61,000, you gain 1,000 × 0.01 = 10 USDT.
lines.say: Long zero point zero one B-T-C at sixty thousand. If the price rises to sixty-one thousand, you gain one thousand times zero point zero one equals ten U-S-D-T.

lines.text: But if it falls to 59,000, you lose 10 USDT. A long loses when the price falls.
lines.say: But if it falls to fifty-nine thousand, you lose ten U-S-D-T. A long loses when the price falls.

lines.text: Going short means opening a position that gains if the price falls.
lines.say: Going short means opening a position that gains if the price falls.

lines.text: Like a shopkeeper who agrees today to sell rice next week at today's price, before she buys it.
lines.say: Like a shopkeeper who agrees today to sell rice next week at today's price, before she buys it.

lines.text: If rice gets cheaper, she buys it for less and keeps the difference. If it gets dearer, she loses.
lines.say: If rice gets cheaper, she buys it for less and keeps the difference. If it gets dearer, she loses.

lines.text: Short 0.01 BTC at 60,000. A fall to 59,000 gains 10 USDT. A rise to 61,000 loses 10 USDT.
lines.say: Short zero point zero one B-T-C at sixty thousand. A fall to fifty-nine thousand gains ten U-S-D-T. A rise to sixty-one thousand loses ten U-S-D-T.

lines.text: Now watch one price, with a long and a short opened at the same 60,000.
lines.say: Now watch one price, with a long and a short opened at the same sixty thousand.

lines.text: The price climbs to 61,500. The long shows +15 USDT, the short −15 USDT.
lines.say: The price climbs to sixty-one thousand five hundred. The long shows plus fifteen U-S-D-T, the short minus fifteen U-S-D-T.

lines.text: Then the market reverses and falls to 58,500. The results flip.
lines.say: Then the market reverses and falls to fifty-eight thousand five hundred. The results flip.

lines.text: Now the long is down 15 USDT and the short is up 15. Same move, opposite results.
lines.say: Now the long is down fifteen U-S-D-T and the short is up fifteen. Same move, opposite results.

lines.text: A common mistake: thinking buying spot is the same as going long with margin.
lines.say: A common mistake: thinking buying spot is the same as going long with margin.

lines.text: Spot: you pay the full 600 USDT and own 0.01 BTC. If the price drops, you still hold the coins.
lines.say: Spot: you pay the full six hundred U-S-D-T and own zero point zero one B-T-C. If the price drops, you still hold the coins.

lines.text: Margin is a deposit that lets you hold a bigger futures position. Losses come out of it.
lines.say: Margin is a deposit that lets you hold a bigger futures position. Losses come out of it.

lines.text: If losses eat that deposit, the exchange can close your position. That's liquidation.
lines.say: If losses eat that deposit, the exchange can close your position. That's liquidation.

lines.text: And selling coins you own is not shorting. A short is a new position that gains if price falls.
lines.say: And selling coins you own is not shorting. A short is a new position that gains if price falls.

lines.text: Your call. Long, short, or wait? Pick one in your head before the price moves.
lines.say: Your call. Long, short, or wait? Pick one in your head before the price moves.

lines.text: Here's the move: up first, then down, ending at 59,800.
lines.say: Here's the move: up first, then down, ending at fifty-nine thousand eight hundred.

lines.text: Long: minus 2 USDT. Short: plus 2 USDT. Wait: nothing gained, nothing lost.
lines.say: Long: minus two U-S-D-T. Short: plus two U-S-D-T. Wait: nothing gained, nothing lost.

lines.text: Nobody knows the next move for sure. Choosing to wait is always allowed.
lines.say: Nobody knows the next move for sure. Choosing to wait is always allowed.

lines.text: Your turn. A short of 0.02 BTC at 60,000. The price rises to 60,500. Profit or loss? Pause if needed.
lines.say: Your turn. A short of zero point zero two B-T-C at sixty thousand. The price rises to sixty thousand five hundred. Profit or loss? Pause if needed.

lines.text: A loss of 10 USDT. A short loses when the price rises: 500 × 0.02 = 10.
lines.say: A loss of ten U-S-D-T. A short loses when the price rises: five hundred times zero point zero two equals ten.

lines.text: That's before fees. Well done if you said loss: that's the key idea.
lines.say: That's before fees. Well done if you said loss: that's the key idea.

lines.text: Before we go on, the risks.
lines.say: Before we go on, the risks.

lines.text: A price can keep rising, so a short's possible loss has no fixed limit.
lines.say: A price can keep rising, so a short's possible loss has no fixed limit.

lines.text: Margin and leverage make losses bigger too, and can lead to liquidation.
lines.say: Margin and leverage make losses bigger too, and can lead to liquidation.

lines.text: Fees come out of every result. Futures also have funding: regular payments between longs and shorts.
lines.say: Fees come out of every result. Futures also have funding: regular payments between longs and shorts.

lines.text: And no one can promise the next move. Waiting is always a valid choice.
lines.say: And no one can promise the next move. Waiting is always a valid choice.

lines.text: Let's recap.
lines.say: Let's recap.

lines.text: Spot buying means owning the coin. Selling spot means exiting it.
lines.say: Spot buying means owning the coin. Selling spot means exiting it.

lines.text: A long gains when the price rises. A short gains when it falls.
lines.say: A long gains when the price rises. A short gains when it falls.

lines.text: Futures use margin and can be liquidated. And waiting is always allowed.
lines.say: Futures use margin and can be liquidated. And waiting is always allowed.

lines.text: Check yourself: BTC falls 1,000 USDT. Which position gains, long or short?
lines.say: Check yourself: B-T-C falls one thousand U-S-D-T. Which position gains, long or short?

lines.text: The short gains. The long loses. Same move, opposite sides.
lines.say: The short gains. The long loses. Same move, opposite sides.

lines.text: Next up, T06: entry, exit, and how to work out profit and loss. See you there!
lines.say: Next up, T six: entry, exit, and how to work out profit and loss. See you there!
